description: Round 3 retrieval evaluation. An authored NOVA TECH guideline corpus (one passage per page) and labelled queries. 'exact' queries reuse the passage's own words; 'paraphrase' queries describe the same thing in different words. Gold = the page that answers the query.

passages.text: Brand Identity: NOVA TECH builds premium AI laptops for professionals. Our mission is dependable, verifiable performance. Always write the company name as NOVA TECH in capitals.
Brand Voice & Tone: The NOVA TECH voice is calm, precise and confident. Avoid hype, slang and exclamation marks. Prefer measured statements backed by data.
Pricing Policy: NovaBook AI Pro 16 official launch price is strictly ₹79,999 (inclusive of taxes). Promotional prices must be approved by the pricing committee before use.
Processor Specification: The NovaCore N10 AI Engine delivers 45 TOPS of NPU performance with a sustained 3.8 GHz clock speed under the standard thermal profile.
Battery Endurance: NovaBook AI Pro 16 is rated for up to 18 hours of mixed productivity workload. Results vary with brightness and usage; always include 'up to'.
Warranty: Every NovaBook includes a 2-Year On-Site Limited Hardware Warranty. Accidental damage is not covered unless the customer buys NovaCare Plus.
Advertising Claims & Competitor Comparisons: Superlatives such as fastest, best or number one need an independent benchmark report. Never claim to beat every competitor.
Prohibited Terms: Do not describe products as cheap, budget or bargain. Use exceptional value or highly accessible instead.
Product Naming: Always use the full name NovaBook AI Pro 16 on first mention. Never shorten it to Nova laptop, NB16 or AI Pro.
Trademarks: NovaBook and NovaCore are registered trademarks. Use the ® symbol on the first mention in print and legal documents.
Promotional Offers: The pre-order bonus (complimentary NovaSleeve accessory) applied only to the 2024 launch window and expired on 31 December 2024.
Logo Usage: Keep clear space around the logo equal to the height of the letter N. Never stretch, rotate, recolour or add effects to the logo.
Logo Colours: Use the monochrome logo on photographs and dark backgrounds. The indigo logo is reserved for white backgrounds only.
Colour Palette: Primary colour Indigo #4F46E5, secondary Slate #0F172A, accent Emerald #10B981. Do not introduce new brand colours without approval.
Typography: Headlines use Inter Bold; body copy uses Inter Regular at 14 to 16 pixels. Never use more than two type weights in one layout.
Accessibility: Text must meet WCAG AA contrast of at least 4.5 to 1. Provide alt text for every product image.
Social Media: Posts on X stay under 280 characters. Use at most two hashtags and always include the product link.
Email Marketing: Subject lines must be under 60 characters, must not use all capitals and must include an unsubscribe link in the footer.
Regional Disclaimers (India): Any price shown must be followed by T&C apply. EMI offers must state subject to bank approval and any processing fee.
Financing: No-cost EMI is available for 3, 6 and 9 months through partner banks only. Do not promise zero interest for other tenures.
Display: The 16-inch 3.2K OLED panel offers a 120 Hz refresh rate and 100 percent DCI-P3 colour coverage.
Memory and Storage: Standard configuration is 32 GB LPDDR5X RAM and a 1 TB PCIe Gen 4 SSD. Never describe RAM as storage.
Weight and Build: The chassis is CNC-machined aluminium and weighs 1.6 kg. Thickness is 14.9 mm at the thinnest point.
Charging: The bundled 100 W USB-C charger refills 50 percent of the battery in about 30 minutes.
Sustainability: The chassis uses 50 percent recycled aluminium and the packaging is plastic-free. Do not call the product carbon neutral.
Customer Support: Support is available 24/7 by chat and phone. On-site engineers reach metro cities within two business days.
Partner Co-branding: Partner logos may appear only in the footer at no more than half the size of the NOVA TECH logo, with written approval.
Influencer Guidelines: Paid creators must disclose the partnership with #ad or Paid partnership labels at the start of the post.
Imagery: Use real product photography. Do not show the laptop with competitor devices or with altered screen content.
Video: Every video must show the product name on screen in the first three seconds and include captions.
Security Features: Includes a fingerprint reader, IR camera for face login and a hardware security chip. Do not claim the device cannot be hacked.
Software: Ships with Windows 11 Pro and NovaSuite. AI features require a one-time online activation.
Availability: Sales begin on 15 November 2026 in India through the NOVA TECH online store and authorised retailers.
Returns: Customers may return an unopened product within 10 days of delivery for a full refund.
Approval Workflow: All campaigns require reviewer approval and a Brand Passport before publication. Edited copy must be approved again.
Translation: Translated campaigns must keep numbers, prices and qualifiers such as up to exactly as in the approved English source.
